Subject: Recap & Mutual Action Plan 0 Redwood + Acme discovery (Sept 14)

Hi Sarah 0

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed Mutual Action Plan attached for your review (attached: acme-mutual-action-plan.xlsx). I captured the high-level items we discussed and suggested owners/timing so we have alignment on next steps.

Key pain points you mentioned:
- Token and inference costs are spiking as Acme scales nightly summarization jobs.
- Latency variability impacting customer-facing features (mobile and web).
- Need for data isolation and audit logs for compliance teams.

Goals we heard:
- Reduce per-token cost by ~30% for batch processing while keeping p95 latency under 300ms for interactive flows.
- Validate an integration in a 4-6 week POC, then move to Dedicated capacity.
- Ensure SOC 2 evidence & KMS integration for procurement.

Proposed next steps (see MAP attachment):
1) Week of Sept 20 0 Technical kickoff (Redwood eng + Acme ML/Infra) 0 owner: Marissa (Redwood) / Michael (Acme)
2) Sept 27 0 Deliver POC plan, dataset & success metrics 0 owner: Dylan (Redwood)
3) Oct 11 0 Start 4-week POC (target completion Nov 8) 0 owner: Acme prod/infra + Redwood
4) Oct 20 0 Procurement & legal review (target decision by Oct 31) 0 owner: Joe (Acme)

Open questions for you (will update MAP after you confirm):
- Can you confirm the procurement timeline and who will own the purchase order?
- Who else on your side needs to be looped into the technical kickoff (we recommend the infra lead and security reviewer)?

I'll follow up with an updated MAP and a calendar invite for the kickoff. Also attaching a short SOC 2 summary we typically share with RFPs (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf).

Thanks 0 happy to adjust anything in the plan.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0142

- Stakeholders to include: Michael Chen (CTO) 0 I'll loop him into the kickoff once we lock timing; Joe Ramirez (procurement) is CC'd and will own purchase order timelines.

I'll review the attached MAP with Michael and Joe and will confirm the kickoff attendees by Fri, Sept 17.

Appreciate it 0 Sarah
